in_arabic.name: مُتَعَزّ
in_arabic.meaning: المتعز بالله، من يعتمد على الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُتَعَزّ هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني من يعتمد على الله ويتكل عليه في جميع أموره، اسم يدل على معنى الاعتماد والتوكل على الله تعالى. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَن يَتَوَكَل عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ'.

in_urdu.name: متعز

in_english.name: Mutaz
in_english.long_meaning: Mutaz is a name derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ز-ز' meaning 'to rely on' or 'to trust in'. It signifies one who places their trust and reliance on Allah. The name has a strong Quranic background, reflecting the spiritual significance of Tawakkul (reliance on Allah) in Islam. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a profound connection with divine providence.

This name also holds a historical significance, as 'Mutazilis' were a group of Islamic scholars who advocated for rational reasoning and a literal interpretation of religious texts.

Al-Mutaz ibn Umar al-Azdi was a prominent poet during the Umayyad period (7th-8th century). He is known for his panegyric and satirical verses, and his poetry often reflected the political and social conditions of the time.
